newsitem.title: UK: Norwich Union 96 new UK business up 37 pct.
newsitem.headline: Norwich Union 96 new UK business up 37 pct.

text.p: British insurance group Norwich Union Life Insurance Society said on Monday that new British life, pensions and savings business rose 37 percent in 1996 to 224 million stg.
Worldwide life, pensions and savings business as up 15 percent at 354 million stg, Norwich Union said in a statement.
The insurer said total new annual premiums in Britain were up 28 percent at 98 million stg and single premium business rose 46 percent to 1.3 billion.
Single premium life and savings business expanded more than five-fold while annual premium life and savings business was up 21 percent at 26 million stg.
Abroad, business dropped 10 percent to 129 million stg but Norwich Union said that was better than expected.
